channel.title: Tachyon Webmail News & Announcements
channel.description: Latest updates, releases, and security announcements from Tachyon Webmail.

item.title: Let There Be Light... or Dark... or Light
item.dc:creator: Kim Schulz
item.description: Why have two themes when one toggle does the trick? We cleaned up Tachyon's theme roster, merged 7 light/dark theme duplicates into unified adaptive themes, and retired 8 legacy names with seamless auto-migration.

item.title: Real-Time Localization Tracking: Coordinating 36 Languages for Tachyon
item.dc:creator: Kim Schulz
item.description: Introducing our new live translation dashboard on tachyonmail.app, tracking localization progress across 36 languages with direct GitHub contribution links.

item.title: Hardening Webmail: Zero Trackers, Strict CSP & Sodium Cryptography
item.dc:creator: Kim Schulz
item.description: A deep dive into Tachyon's security model: why we ditched third-party telemetry, how we enforce strict Content-Security-Policy headers, and our cryptographic design.

item.title: Tachyon v4.0.1 – v4.0.2 Released: Critical Fixes for Contacts, UTF-8 & CalDAV
item.dc:creator: Kim Schulz
item.description: Following the v4.0 rollout, several critical issues were identified and promptly resolved in the v4.0.1 and v4.0.2 patch releases, including contact selection deletion bugs, UTF-8 send corruption, and CalDAV auth.

item.title: Tachyon v4.0 Released: Modern PHP 8.4 Architecture & Enhanced Security
item.dc:creator: Kim Schulz
item.description: We are thrilled to announce Tachyon v4.0! This major release brings full PHP 8.4 compatibility, hardened security headers, and an automated release build pipeline.

item.title: Tachyon v3.2.4: vCard Categories, Group Tagging & Nextcloud 34 Support
item.dc:creator: Kim Schulz
item.description: Major contacts overhaul with vCard CATEGORIES support, address book group chips in compose autocomplete, and Nextcloud 34 DI modernizations.

item.title: Tachyon for Nextcloud: Seamless Webmail for Your Cloud
item.dc:creator: Kim Schulz
item.description: Bringing Tachyon directly into Nextcloud and ownCloud environments with automated release artifacts and drop-in SnappyMail upgrade compatibility.

item.title: Tachyon v3.1.0: Custom Branding, Directory Rebrand & Debian Packages
item.dc:creator: Kim Schulz
item.description: The full move to Tachyon: application directories renamed to tachyon/, custom logo uploads for the login screen, new default theme, and official .deb package releases.

item.title: Introducing Tachyon: Why We Forked and Where We're Heading
item.dc:creator: Kim Schulz
item.description: A fast, zero-database webmail client built for modern PHP 8.2+. The story behind the fork from SnappyMail and our vision for a lean, privacy-respecting email engine.
